bibliographic.title: Road of Darkness
bibliographic.author: Aster Fialla
bibliographic.description:
Our heroic adventurer finds themself on a difficult road.

---

Inspired by Cloak of Darkness, this is a tiny adventure designed to be easy to port to a given authoring system. However, Road of Darkness is specifically designed to showcase the features of authoring systems for choice-based IF. Choice-based IF tends to prioritize branching paths, as well as conditional text, choices, and endings over a detailed world model. Therefore, the story and its specification are structured around highlighting those capabilities.
